serves: Reliable planning and resumable work in Prism's spec-driven engineering workflow.

initiatives.title: Single review app
initiatives.intent: Run one review app per user that every agent session and project shares, with a project switcher that shows which project waits on the user.
initiatives.rationale: Now, because Michael asked for it on 2026-10-17 and approved the design direction in the project thread; it builds on the plain-HTTP review server from PR #25.

initiatives.title: Repository intelligence
initiatives.intent: Give workflow agents deterministic repository evidence: providers, context planning, session capacity, structural analysis, and duplication gates.
initiatives.rationale: Kept in Now while repository-intelligence work continues on main.

initiatives.title: Agent execution evidence and continuity
initiatives.intent: Report observed context ranges, keep pause checkpoints current and recoverable, and assess diagram readability.
initiatives.rationale: Next, because observed-range reporting consumes verified ranges from repository context planning, while pause checkpoints and diagram-readability assessment can proceed independently after design. The new work stays together until design shows that its outcomes need separate sequencing.

openQuestions: Should the three outcomes of agent-execution-evidence remain in one initiative after design assigns concrete slices?
Should shipped initiatives be backfilled after the first roadmap baseline is accepted and reviewed against repository history?
